reply:
The catalog has no single component that filters a list. I used `segmented_control` for the status filter next to an `entity_list` of the eight items, but the two are not wired together, so choosing a status will not hide rows. `columns` is the only container available, and it needs at least two columns, so the filter and list sit side by side.

<a2ui>
surface("status-list")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Active", value: "active"}, {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}], "all", "status_filter")
list = entity_list([{name: "Migrate billing service", subtitle: "Cutover scheduled for Friday night", status: "Active"}, {name: "Update onboarding emails", subtitle: "Copy review in progress with marketing", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Fix login timeout bug", subtitle: "Patched and deployed to production", status: "Done"}, {name: "Design new dashboard", subtitle: "Second round of mockups under way", status: "Active"}, {name: "Renew SSL certificates", subtitle: "Waiting on approval from security team", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Archive old reports", subtitle: "All 2022 reports moved to cold storage", status: "Done"}, {name: "Load test checkout API", subtitle: "Running at 5x expected peak traffic", status: "Active"}, {name: "Vendor contract review", subtitle: "Legal has not yet returned comments", status: "Pending"}])
root = columns(2, "1.5rem", "top", [{blocks: [filter]}, {blocks: [list]}])
</a2ui>
